description:
Internal to Cubi's result card — assistants should not call this.

    A listing's AI summary is written in the background the first time the
    listing is shown, so the first cards of a result can lack it. The card
    asks here once the summaries have had time to be written and fills them
    in. Read-only: returns summaries already stored and writes nothing.

    Args:
        listing_ids: Up to 12 ids of listings the card shows.
        lang: ISO 639-1 code of the card's language.

    Returns:
        {summaries: {listing id: summary}} — only for the ids that have one.
